label: CIC::DUX4

sections.text: CIC encodes capicua, a transcriptional repressor regulated by MAPK signaling.
DUX4 encodes a double-homeobox transcription factor normally active during early embryonic development.

The fusion converts CIC-associated transcriptional repression into an oncogenic ETS-target activation program. It is the most frequent fusion in CIC-rearranged sarcoma, a molecularly distinct disease from Ewing sarcoma.
CIC-rearranged sarcoma showed substantially worse survival than BCOR::CCNB3 sarcoma in the retrospective GRACefUl cohort.
